item.text: {"text":"{\"status\":\"NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT\",\"core_findings\":[\"Sampled training margins are positive across all categories, but sampled-user full-catalog training-prefix HR@10 ranges from 0 to 0.292; pairwise separation does not establish strong catalog ranking or held-out performance.\",\"Permutation probes show order sensitivity, including when the terminal item is preserved. Matched replacement evidence covers only two Movies users and one Electronics user, with no completed blocks in Industrial or CDs, so recency comparisons remain inconclusive.\"],\"key_implications\":[\"The model uses history order beyond the terminal item on measured training prefixes; this does not identify user preferences.\",\"Embedding alignment is strongest in Electronics, but cosine measurements alone do not establish representation collapse.\",\"Unresolved construction leaves substantial feasibility uncertainty; pinned host macro validation HR@10 remains authoritative for model selection.\"],\"evidence\":{\"headline_metrics\":{\"training_prefix_hr10_user_mean\":{\"Movies_and_TV\":0.0,\"Industrial_and_Scientific\":0.0417,\"Electronics\":0.125,\"CDs_and_Vinyl\":0.2917},\"pos_neg_margin_mean\":{\"Movies_and_TV\":5.0424,\"Industrial_and_Scientific\":4.2551,\"Electronics\":3.3925,\"CDs_and_Vinyl\":7.8631},\"completed_matched_blocks\":{\"Movies_and_TV\":7,\"Industrial_and_Scientific\":0,\"Electronics\":6,\"CDs_and_Vinyl\":0},\"terminal_preserving_permutation_delta_rank_mean\":{\"Industrial_and_Scientific\":508.75,\"CDs_and_Vinyl\":1386.67},\"Electronics:embedding_collapse_score\":0.6459},\"brief_metric_read\":{\"training_prefix_hr10_user_mean\":\"In-sample full-catalog hits on sampled users; not validation.\",\"pos_neg_margin_mean\":\"Separation from sampled training negatives.\",\"completed_matched_blocks\":\"Sparse completed support; missing effects are not zero effects.\",\"terminal_preserving_permutation_delta_rank_mean\":\"Positive values indicate worse target ranks after reordering earlier history.\",\"Electronics:embedding_collapse_score\":\"Elevated mean cosine alignment; insufficient evidence of collapse.\"}}}"}
